name: Written in the Stars
source:
Adia and her family have crash landed on a foreign planet. Miraculously, everyone seems to be okay, but family members are insisting on arguing with each other. No one seems to be keen on working to mend their starship or prepare for a long and difficult night, and Adia cannot get anyone to listen to her.

[from [url=https://jhompsgamedev.itch.io/written-in-the-stars]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿迪亚和她的家人迫降在一个外国星球上。奇迹般的是，每个人似乎都没事，但家人却坚持互相争吵。似乎没有人热衷于修理他们的星舰或为漫长而艰难的夜晚做准备，而阿迪亚无法让任何人听她的。

[来自[url=https://jhompsgamedev.itch.io/written-in-the-stars]itch.io[/url]]
